name: Birla Niyaara
address: Pandurang Budhkar Marg, opposite Kamala Mills, Worli, Mumbai 400030
amenities: High-end retail and offices within the 14-acre development
description: The flagship residential project of Birla Estates (Aditya Birla Group) within a 14-acre integrated development at Worli, a mix of high-rise homes, retail and offices designed by Foster + Partners. Tower A (Phase 1, 414 homes from 2 to 6 BHK) opened for bookings in February 2022 and was Mumbai's top-selling project of CY2022 with Rs 1,915 crore of bookings. The second tower, Silas (148 homes of 4 and 5 BHK), launched in March 2024 with over Rs 2,500 crore of sales. Cumulative sales passed Rs 5,700 crore by September 2024.
notes: MahaRERA (Square Yards snapshots read 18 Nov 2026): Tower A, P51900031916, 414 apartments, 87 floors (74 habitable), start 22 Nov 2021, completion 31 Mar 2028. Silas / Wing TB, P51900054455, 148 apartments, 48 floors, completion 31 Mar 2029, 80 sold + 36 booked + 32 unsold, 39% construction progress. total_units = 414 + 148. possession_promised is the later (Silas) date. Mumbai Property Exchange lists Jul 2028 / Jul 2029, Housiey a target of Sep 2028 and RERA Mar 2029, and 60% overall completion as of Oct 2026. Mumbai Property Exchange's MahaRERA data shows Tower A's structure 100% complete (55% overall). Units sold: Tower A was 58% of launched units by Q1 FY23 and 93% by June 2024 (Century Textiles); Square Yards says 400 of 415 launched units were booked as of Nov 2025. Silas was 46% sold by June 2024. Because the counts come from different dates, units_sold is not set. Floors: the developer describes 75 storeys, MahaRERA 87. Land: 14 acres for the full integrated development (IIFL / developer); Housiey says 10 acres; Square Yards refers to eight towers in two clusters across the masterplan. Registered price history (computed from MahaRERA agreement values): Tower A 2-3 BHK about Rs 45,000-53,000/sq ft carpet in Mar-Apr 2022, rising to about Rs 74,000-77,000 by mid-2024 and Jan 2025 (about +45-60%). Silas registered at about Rs 90,000-115,000/sq ft carpet from Mar 2024 and about Rs 98,000-110,000 by Oct 2025. Birla Estates itself cited about Rs 80,000/sq ft carpet for Silas at launch. An RP Realty Plus line quoting a launch price of 'Rs 9,000 per sq ft' is clearly wrong and is ignored. Square Yards: 15 registered sales worth Rs 478 crore at an average of Rs 1.01 lakh/sq ft (Nov 2025 - Oct 2026); asking about Rs 1.10 lakh/sq ft in Sep 2026. Listing asking prices are Rs 1.17-1.25 lakh/sq ft for large units. Parent Century Textiles and Industries was renamed Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd. In Sep 2024 it bought an adjacent 10-acre Worli parcel for Rs 1,100 crore, creating a 30-acre contiguous holding. MahaRERA architect of record: Umeshchandra Powar. No floor-rise schedule or maintenance rate was found.
architect: Foster + Partners (design); Sasaki and Coopers Hill (masterplan and landscape)
payment_plan: Construction-linked, slab-wise payments, per Housiey listing

unit_types.notes: Tower A. Registered Rs 3.83-4.16 crore in Mar-Apr 2022 and Rs 6.29-6.56 crore in Jul 2024 - Jan 2025; Housiey lists Rs 8.50 crore all-inclusive (sold out). Early 2 BHKs were below the Rs 5 crore band.

Tower A MahaRERA range. Registered Rs 5.66-6.25 crore in 2022 and Rs 7.87-9.03 crore in 2024-25 for about 1,150-1,205 sq ft; Housiey asks Rs 12 crore for 1,200 sq ft. Silas also has 3 BHK rows of 191.96 sq m (about 2,066 sq ft) at Rs 19.4-21.0 crore.

Tower A has a 1,864 sq ft 4 BHK; Silas 4 BHKs are 258.91-278.93 sq m (about 2,787-3,002 sq ft) and registered at Rs 25.5-33.7 crore in 2024-25. Housiey asks Rs 42.77-45.63 crore for 3,028-3,231 sq ft.
Silas 5 BHKs are 337.65-381.01 sq m (about 3,634-4,101 sq ft) and registered at Rs 34.9-46.3 crore in 2024-25. Housiey asks Rs 56.11-60.61 crore for 3,973-4,291 sq ft.
Tower A duplexes; Mumbai Property Exchange asks Rs 44.34 crore for 3,776 sq ft (Nov 2026).
